# Land Cover Small

A tiny single-band uint8 categorical land-cover raster with an attached colormap (0=nodata, 1=water, 2=vegetation, 3=urban). Exercises categorical / colormap handling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `landcover_small` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:32633` |
| Test tier | integration |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest

    data = geocase_case.load()
```

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase preserves a categorical land-cover raster, its colormap, and its NoData class.

## Risk types covered

- `category_misread`
- `colormap_dropped`
- [`nodata_ignored`](../risk/nodata-ignored.md)
